nom: JIYU Toner Pads - Korean Skincare for Dark Spots

segments.dry: The one reviewer identifying as dry-skinned found the pads gentle and hydrating, with no added dryness or irritation.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination, dullness-prone skin in her 40s reports fading dark spots and smoother texture after three to four weeks, with no stinging, redness, or dryness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several report a burning rash, red swollen patches, or increased redness — one specifically warns against use on sensitive skin — while many others, including a long-time Retin-A user and a reviewer with rosacea, found it calming with zero irritation or breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s to 50s report firmer, smoother skin and fading fine lines, including a 53-year-old long-term Retin-A user who found it effective on sun damage without compromising her sensitized skin barrier.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report visibly softer fine lines and firmer, tighter-feeling skin, most describing the improvement as gradual over several weeks rather than immediate.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers, including one with dry skin, describe the pads as hydrating rather than stripping, leaving skin refreshed without tightness; none report the product causing dryness.
concerns.redness: The product is frequently credited with calming redness over time, but a notable minority report the opposite — a rash, burning, or red swollen patches, sometimes linked to a strong alcohol or menthol content not listed in the online ingredients.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with skin sensitized by decades of Retin-A use reports the pads did not compromise and even reinforced her barrier, while another experienced a reaction serious enough to prompt a dermatologist visit, describing the product as harsh.
concerns.spots: Fading of dark spots, sun spots, and post-acne marks is the most consistently reported effect, typically noticed after two to four weeks of consistent use; a minority report no visible change even after three or more weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers note fewer breakouts and calmer skin with continued use, while at least one reports new pimples appearing on the forehead that worsened after stopping the product.

aspects.libelle: Some jars arrive unsealed or leaking on delivery
Strong alcohol or menthol scent in the formula
Pad is generously soaked, one covers face and neck
Comes with a tweezer tool for hygienic handling
Refreshing, slightly cooling sensation on application
Expensive for the category, though jar lasts months

extraits.texte: This product is harsh on the face!!! Just like Euskin, I also have rashes now on my face; 2 huge red and swollen patches on my cheeks!! The patches are so itchy and warm!! I am seeing my primary doctor this afternoon and I also requested to be referred to a dermatologist asap. Do not buy if you have sensitive skin. Looks like this is made in China and not Korea.

First I cleansed my face with Neutrogena soap like I've been doing for years. It tells you on this container to cleanse your face first then use the pads and massage the pads on your face. After using this for two days so far, my face was burning and turning red. I'm sad I cannot use this product. If you have very sensitive skin, only try this product on a small area of your skin to test it out. Maybe I'll try it one more time without cleansing my face with Neutrogena soap and use regular soap.

extraits.texte: 5/5 Stars: Finally Found Toner Pads That Deliver Real Results At 53, I've been using Retin-A consistently for over 20 years and have tested countless skincare products. These JIYU Toner Pads genuinely impressed me—a rare compliment from someone with serious skincare experience. What Works: Living in Hawaii means constant sun exposure, and despite religious daily sunscreen use, I've dealt with stubborn brown spots and age-related dullness. These pads have visibly brightened my complexion in just a few weeks. The difference is noticeable, especially on areas that tend to look dull and damaged from UV exposure. The Best Part: They're powerful and gentle. As someone whose skin is primed for sensitivity (thanks to decades of Retin-A), I was cautious. These haven't irritated my skin or compromised my barrier—they've actually enhanced it. The combination of snail mucin, niacinamide, peptides, and centella works. You can feel the quality. The Value: 100 count means real longevity. They're becoming a non-negotiable part of my routine—morning and evening. For anyone dealing with sun damage, age spots, or that flat, tired look that comes with decades of sun exposure, these are legitimately worth trying. If you're skeptical about toner pads, I get it. I was too. But these proved me wrong.

I’m normally not one to write reviews, but I have to say this one earned it. I am almost 50 years old and have very very sensitive skin on top of terrible rosacea and sun spots from years and years of tanning bed use. I know,,, Looking back I definitely would’ve done things much differently for my poor Skin. But do to my sensitive skin, very few products work without breaking me out and after reading so many of these reviews and feeling hopeful, I decided to give it a try. I am so glad I did… 100% this product is AWESOME!!!. It makes my skin feel wonderful and after just a few days of using it, my face has never looked so clear. So far no reactions, no breakouts.. Hands down. I am in love.

I have dry skin, so I'm always careful with what I use-especially toners. These JiYu toner pads have been such a nice surprise. They're super gentle and smooth out my skin without any irritation or dryness. After using them, my skin feels refreshed, calm, and hydrated. I love that they don't leave any sticky residue and prep my skin really well for moisturizer. Definitely a new favorite in my routine!

extraits.titre: Game-Changer for Dark Spots and Dull Skin – Loving These K-Beauty Pads!
extraits.texte: I’ve been dealing with stubborn dark spots from old acne and sun damage (I’m in my 40s, combo skin that’s prone to dullness), and these JiYu Toning Polish Pads have seriously impressed me after about 3-4 weeks of consistent use. The pads are thick, generously soaked (no dry ones at the bottom of the jar!), and have a subtle refreshing eucalyptus-like scent that’s not overpowering. They feel mildly exfoliating thanks to the gentle acids/formula, but super soothing at the same time – no stinging, redness, or dryness, even on sensitive areas. I swipe one over my face and neck after cleansing (morning and night), and it instantly makes my skin feel smoother, more hydrated, and brighter. The glow is real – people have asked if I got a facial! Key wins for me: • Dark spots (especially on cheeks and forehead) are noticeably fading and less intense. • Skin texture is smoother, pores look smaller, and overall tone is more even. • Fine lines around my eyes and mouth seem softer – the snail mucin, niacinamide, peptides, centella, and alpha-arbutin combo really delivers hydration + brightening without being harsh. • Great for daily use; no purging or breakouts (actually calmed some redness). Only tiny downside: If you have very sensitive skin, start with once a day to test, but I had zero issues. Highly recommend if you’re chasing that clear, glowy Korean skincare look and targeting dark spots/wrinkles/dullness. These are staying in my routine!

extraits.titre: Not impressed. Didn’t do anything for me
extraits.texte: I’m not sure what all the hype is about. I’ve been using this for about 3 weeks morning and night and I’ve seen no difference. I guess it can just be me but was hoping it’d make a difference in my sun spots. I think they must just pay a lot of money on influencer marketing. I also emailed their email regarding satisfaction guarantee and it says they will respond in 24 hours. It’s been over a week and no response.
